question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 11 to 16. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing ‘12’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d56cfaf3bcd39bea96eba3ea18207b4a24f34df5a20207731b16e935dc9f0410.png]
solution:
Given :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d56cfaf3bcd39bea96eba3ea18207b4a24f34df5a20207731b16e935dc9f0410.png] 

**Explanation: **

 13 and 14 numbers are common in both of the dices so, now if we rotate the dice from 13 clockwise or anti clockwise direction from the given diagram it is evident that 13 is adjacent to 14 and **12 is opposite to 11.**

Hence, **11** is the **correct answer**.
